summary: Enhance your expertise in AML, CFT, CPF, and sanctions compliance with our comprehensive reinsurance training course. Enroll today for a secure future.
lede: AML/CFT/CPF compliance in reinsurance focuses on identifying and managing financial crime risks across complex transactions and business relationships. For compliance officers, risk and ERM professionals, underwriters, treaty managers, brokers and auditors, the course covers assessing cedants, brokers and retrocessionaires, applying customer due diligence, and strengthening transaction monitoring, sanctions screening and risk-based controls.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who play crucial roles in identifying and mitigating financial crime risks within the reinsurance sector.
audience: Reinsurance brokers and cedant relationship managers
Legal, corporate governance, and regulatory affairs teams
modules: AML/CFT/CPF Foundations and Reinsurance Risk Landscape
Global Regulatory Framework and FATF Guidance
Financial Crime Risk Assessment: Inherent, Control Effectiveness, Residual
Customer Risk Assessment for Cedants, Brokers, Retrocessionaires
Jurisdiction, Product, and Delivery Channel Risk Analysis
Customer Due Diligence, EDD, and Know-Your-Cedant/Broker Procedures
Sanctions Risk, Screening, and Proliferation Finance Controls
Governance, Internal Controls, Record-Keeping & 3 Lines of Defense
Emerging Threats in Financial Crime and Reinsurance
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of AML/CFT/CPF principles and possess experience in the reinsurance or financial services sector.
